about: Package 6 (generation, the go bar, Latest, the player, the song menu, the toast stack): every scenario this package makes runnable, each with what it exercises. 36-generate.mjs holds on the concept page too (--page hotstep-tiers.html), except its scenarios marked pending (the concept's own findings, built here) and a-refusal-the-server-makes (the rebuild's simulated server). Entries waiting on package 4 type into or read the prompt card; `excluded` lists the scenarios that touch generation but whose subject or precondition is another package's.

scenarios.why: Generate from press to queue: one card per take, Cancel all with its count, the badge on Generate with its label kept, the count in the document's title, the sweep across Generate (--gf), the cards' stage and their colours coming into focus (--f), Ctrl+Enter queueing behind (C-26, B-11, M-12, G-M-06).

The queue: × on one song (the rest carry on), the first run finishing and the next starting, Cancel all, its Undo re-queueing the runs as they were started and saying the one rendering starts again, Redo, and Ctrl+Z (F-13; store/desk.ts recordStep).
A run ending: the pending cards resolve into songs, take badges (C-11), the unheard marks (C-45), no toast while the card is in sight, Generate at rest, the count line (F-27).
A run ending with its card out of sight is said in a toast.
A run keeps the engine it started on, whatever is selected later.
The refusal of an empty box per engine (S-05) with Use the example (refusalOf).
The go bar's status line: tier, modules, changes as a link that pulses the changed controls (B-14), its title, hidden and parked counts (E-13; goLine, changedKeys).
The line's Won't fit with Use N takes (G-B-08), and ACE-Step's passes.
Pending (F-21) in the concept, right here: a run certain not to fit is not started; the way out pulses and the line is said.

Rebuild only (the simulated server's card made smaller with mockCard): the server's refusal as a one-line notice (G-D-09), said in sight, Retry with the takes that fit and Dismiss with focus on Generate (F-13), no second identical notice (F-21).
Rebuild only (mockFail): a run the server stops part-way is a notice with Run it again, which queues it as it was started, and Dismiss.
Pending (F-13) in the concept, right here: × on a queued song puts focus on Generate.
Pending (F-22) in the concept, right here: separate presses each queue a run; a double-click queues one.
Pending (F-37) in the concept, right here: beforeunload is refused while songs render.
Pending (F-27) in the concept, right here: after a reload the songs the server did not keep are said once.
Latest's cards: a finished card's marks and names, whole rows (D-26), the queue folded behind +N waiting and opened (C-47; latestShown).
The player in the go bar: play, the position, pause, End, Home, arrows and Shift, Space from the player and from the page (C-27), the end resting paused at the start, stop.
The song menu: focus on its first item, its name, its items, arrows, Home, End, Escape refocusing its button, the ⋯ toggling it, the other pages' message, a click outside.
Reuse its description: the text it was made from back in the box as one step, the toast with Undo (E-20).
Repaint a region from another engine: one step switching to ACE-Step with Repaint first and the song as its source, the switch toast, Generate's label, Undo (E-14; repaintDesk).

The VRAM meter while a run renders: the needle swings toward what it needs, the engine marked live, another engine rendering said with what it holds (B-34; package 5 left it here: meterModel with the run, meterTarget).
Package 2 left them here: the re-planning dice light up with the tries the run reports, and the cover swatch takes the newest song's colour (desk.songs, readoutModel).
The toast stack (F-12): an older message moves up, keeps its Undo and stands above; the same plain message twice is said once.
Pending (F-18) in the concept, right here: three plain messages never push out an Undo, three show at most, Escape on a toast's button dismisses it.
Tab into a toast that carries Undo and back (C-13).
Boots with the six songs the simulated server holds (S.songs), and a reload keeps them.
The line's N changes counts the changes, pulses the changed controls, and says when they are in a hidden module (changesUnmarked, Q-15).
The line counts what is parked with the board's count (B-12).
The line counts hidden and parked once each (E-13).
Pedals just added are no changes, a real one is, and the link never claims a hidden module (S-04).
Repaint from MiniMax-Music3: the item says it switches, one press switches with Repaint on the desk and the song as its source, the toast, Ctrl+Z (E-14).
Latest's cards show their whole description on two lines, the ⋯ shares the title's line only, the count line (F-14, F-27).
Pending (F-18) in the concept, right here: plain messages never push out the Undo toast; Escape on its button dismisses it.
Pending (F-28) in the concept, right here: the song menu stays clear of the go bar and inside the centre column.
Pending (S-16) in the concept, right here: Tab in the song menu closes it and focus goes on from its button.
Generate from an empty box (Use the example fills #prompt), takes, Ctrl+Enter from #prompt, the queue, Cancel and its Undo, finished cards.
